title: Prolog 01 - Van w dżungli
description: Jedno ciągłe szerokie ujęcie z niskiej kamery podążającej kilka kroków za Van Sabe. Van przeciska się samotnie w głąb mokrej, gęstej dżungli i zatrzymuje przy splątanych korzeniach. Ujęcie wyłącznie ustanawia miejsce, izolację i cel marszu; K20 nie jest jeszcze pokazana, nie ma zmiany kąta ani ukrytego cięcia.

prompts.image: Hyperrealistic cinematic live-action 16:9 opening frame. Use the Van Sabe portrait as the exact facial identity reference, his silhouette as the exact full-body proportions and all-black explorer wardrobe reference, and the Allpahuayo-Mishana photograph as the real environment reference. A low wide camera follows several steps behind Van walking alone along a wet leaf-covered path into dense Amazon rainforest near Iquitos. Van occupies the central-right third in a three-quarter rear view; preserve his shoulder-length curly black hair, worn black jacket, black shirt and trousers, rugged boots, brown leather cross-body strap and weathered satchel. Dense layered vegetation, vines, wet leaves and tall trees form strong leading lines into the jungle. Humid late-afternoon light filtered through canopy, grounded adventure-noir mood, restrained green palette, subtle 35 mm grain. Exactly one person. No K20 visible, no ruins, temple, magic, weapons, text, logos, watermark, collage, split screen or montage.
prompts.animation: Duration 3 seconds, one continuous shot. The camera makes a very slow, stable forward tracking movement at hip height, staying several steps behind Van Sabe. Van takes two cautious steps down the wet path; his shoulders and satchel move naturally, nearby leaves brush lightly against his clothes, and the lowest foreground foliage shifts from the camera passing. At the end he slows and turns his head only slightly toward tangled roots ahead, without revealing the K20. Preserve his exact identity, body proportions, black outfit, boots, leather strap and satchel. Preserve the path, vegetation and natural lighting. No new people, no K20, no ruins, no camera cut, no angle change, no zoom, no morphing, no anatomy errors, no extra limbs, no text, no logo and no watermark.
